title: Chapter 32
content:

"Wait... Director Kang. Director Kang?"

Ignoring the protests entirely, Il-hyun slid a large hand past Jakyeong’s waistband, pushing deep inside his slacks while his mouth descended back to Jakyeong’s bare chest.

Jakyeong squeezed his eyes shut against the assault. He could break the hold easily enough with a strike to the solar plexus, but Jang Yi-an wasn't capable of hand-to-hand combat.

Il-hyun’s expression was intoxicatingly depraved. The crooked smirk, the dark irises glazed with primal hunger, the deliberate swipe of his tongue across his own bottom lip... The sheer erotic pressure was suffocating, forcing Jakyeong to avert his gaze.

The threat was dripping with dark, damp promise.

Reaching the edge, Il-hyun gritted his teeth, his head snapping back as a low, gravelly curse tore from his throat. The cords in his neck stood out in sharp relief, his pulse hammering visibly against his throat.

His breathing turned entirely feral, the rhythm of his fist accelerating to a frantic blur. The tension in his jaw was terrifying. With a strangled, guttural groan, a thick, searing pulse erupted over Jakyeong’s face.

Once. Twice. Three times...

Warm, heavy liquid splattered across his eyelids, the bridge of his nose, and dripped slowly down his cheek.

Panting heavily like a predator catching its breath after a kill, Il-hyun stared down through the haze, his eyes locked onto Jakyeong. The lingering euphoria of his release curved his lips into a striking, breathtaking grin.

Frozen by the spectacle, Jakyeong only snapped back to reality when the sticky mess began cooling against his skin.

Scowling, he raised a hand to wipe his face, but Il-hyun caught his wrist mid-air. Leaning down, Il-hyun extended his tongue, slowly licking the semen from Jakyeong’s cheek and jawline.

Jakyeong stiffened in pure horror. He shoved at Il-hyun's shoulders, but the man was like an unyielding monolith, mouth working over his skin, sucking and lapping as if determined to consume him entirely.

Unable to bear it a second longer, Jakyeong wrenched an arm free and shoved the man's face away.

"Stop... Stop it!"

Il-hyun merely dragged his tongue across the palm pushed against his mouth, then took Jakyeong’s index finger between his lips, sucking it clean. Jakyeong yanked his hand back with a violent tug. The man looked ready to swallow everything in sight.

With a trace of white fluid glistening on his lower lip, Il-hyun whispered in a low rasp:

"I want more."

The sharp chime of the bedroom intercom broke the trance.

The moment Il-hyun looked toward the wall unit, Jakyeong rolled off the mattress, scrambling to his feet. He smoothed his rumpled clothes, dragged a hand through his tangled hair, and backed toward the exit.

Il-hyun crooked a finger, gesturing for him to return, but Jakyeong shook his head vigorously. Seeing the man step off the bed, Jakyeong bolted through the door.

In the living room, Park Tae-soo was seated on the sofa alongside another staff member. Feeling their stares burn into him, Jakyeong’s ears flushed red with mortification.

Cursing a blue streak in his mind, he sprinted up the stairs to his suite. Locking himself in the bathroom, he scrubbed his face under freezing water, the lingering musky scent only fueling his frustration.

And then came the ultimate indignity.

"Fuck me..."

Tugging down his waistband, Jakyeong looked inside.

Beneath his briefs, a rock-hard erection was straining fiercely against the cotton. He squeezed his eyes shut in pure self-loathing. He hadn't been touched, yet his body had reacted on pure visual cue—hardening the moment Il-hyun had looked down at him with those hungry, predatory eyes.

Filling the marble basin with ice-cold water, Jakyeong submerged his entire face. When he finally surfaced, the flushed skin beneath his eyes was burning crimson in the mirror.

"...Damn it all."

He scrubbed his face with rough towel strikes, then paced the bathroom, chaining several e-cigarettes in rapid succession. Part of him wanted to laugh at the sheer absurdity, while another wanted to put a bullet through something. Even after twenty minutes, the heat in his groin refused to fully subside, Kang Il-hyun’s mocking laughter echoing through his head.

Drifting lazily on an oversized pool float, Kang Seok-joo reclined with designer sunglasses perched on his nose.

The midday sun was warm, tempered by a gentle mountain breeze—ideal conditions for lounging. Blasting club EDM from his smartphone, Seok-joo shifted his weight, rocking the inflatable raft to the beat.

Before leaving for his trip, Il-hyun had given Seok-joo free rein over the estate and even left behind a keycard for his private Seoul penthouse. It was an exceptionally generous payout—one that Jakyeong had unwittingly paid for by serving as a morning masturbation prop. The only catch was that Park Tae-soo was assigned to shadow them at all times.

Tae-soo was just as impenetrable as Il-hyun; reading the man’s mind was an exercise in futility.

Jakyeong had eventually been forced to handle his morning erection by hand before stepping outside. He’d tried closing his eyes to summon memories of beautiful women—an operative in Russia, a dancer in Italy—yet every attempt had been overwritten by the vivid image of Kang Il-hyun panting above him.

Thirsty, Jakyeong drained the iced beverage the staff had brought out, chewing the crushed ice between his teeth. Hearing the crunch, Seok-joo dialed down the music.

"Yi-an."

"Yeah?"

"There's a party tonight. You in?"

"What party?"

"A bash hosted by Choi Ki-tae. I told you, didn't I? The second his brother was in the ground, the bastard would throw a celebratory rager."

Seok-joo snickered, waiting for an answer.

After a heartbeat's calculation, Jakyeong nodded. Ki-tae's cryptic comment about meeting soon had clearly been an invitation to this gathering. With Kang Il-hyun out of the picture, tonight was the perfect operational window to move—even with Tae-soo acting as an anchor.

"Where did Director Kang travel for business, anyway?"

"Hong Kong."

"Ah... I pray someone puts a bullet in him over there."

Jakyeong gave a tight, ambiguous smile. Not a chance. That contract belongs to me.

As he crushed another ice cube between his molars, Park Tae-soo stepped onto the stone patio, watching the pair from the shade of the portico. Seok-joo clamped his mouth shut instantly, while Jakyeong continued chewing his ice with practiced indifference.

After observing them in silence for several long moments, Tae-soo turned and retreated inside.

Seok-joo pushed his sunglasses up into his hair, glaring at the empty doorway. "The master and his dog... equally repulsive."

"Has Chief Park worked here for a long time...?"

Seok-joo tilted his head, mentally counting the years. "About ten, I think. Rumor has it he came from some classified black-ops unit, but who knows? Kang Il-hyun brought him in personally."

"That's quite a tenure..."

"Hard to believe, but everyone under Il-hyun stays forever. He treats his family like dogshit, but he pays his inner circle insane money and takes care of them. Cross him, though, and you're buried that afternoon. Take the senior housekeeper—she's been with him since the day he was born. She was around long before his mother lost her mind and died."

"Lost her mind...?"

Seok-joo tapped his temple, twirling his index finger in a circle.

"Look at him—it’s obvious, isn't it? His mother committed suicide during a psychotic break. Il-hyun was in and out of psych wards his whole childhood. If Father hadn't forced him into shape, God knows what kind of monster he'd be right now."

Seok-joo shuddered, genuinely unnerved by the mental image. "Fuck... just thinking about it makes me want to piss myself."

Jakyeong recalled the conversation by the pool last night—Il-hyun asking what it felt like to have a mother. Was that fleeting warmth in those dark eyes genuine longing, or merely another layer of manipulation?

Jakyeong shook his head, instantly clearing the thought.

This is what Wang Han warned me about. Lingering around a target too long invited empathy, blurring the professional line until the trigger couldn't be pulled. He had seen plenty of operatives ruin their careers—and lose their lives—over misplaced sentiment.

Lee Ja-kyeong would never make that mistake. That was an amateur's failure, and he was far from an amateur.
